subject: prd/implement-now
statement: While the ready implementation frontier and applicable review frontier are both empty, the executor shall consume no model tokens. A normal invocation may process the durable in-scope review frontier created during that invocation; a review-only recovery invocation shall process only FR-46's non-empty selected set and shall perform zero implementation routing, claims, workers, or proposal operations. An empty selected recovery set is invalid rather than idle success.
rationale: zero work stays free without letting a recovery request widen, redispatch, or misclassify an invalid empty selection
fit_criterion: combined-empty normal fixtures emit zero work; normal pending-review fixtures reconcile only applicable obligations; selected recovery fixtures touch only members and no implementation path; empty selection fails before preflight/model work
